customer_intent: Inquired about CRM software features, pricing, and 5 seats license.
customer_requirements: Needs CRM for 5 users with owner approval.
summary: Customer inquired about CRM software for 5 seats. Requested callback next Monday 10 AM.
transcript: Namaste, main Rahul baat kar raha hu ABC Solutions se. Kya meri baat Sharma ji se ho rahi hai? Haan ji, hamare naye CRM software package ke baare me baat karni thi. Aapne pichle hafte hamari website par inquiry submit ki thi. Wahi pricing aur features discuss karne ke liye call kiya tha. Aapka budget kitna hai aur kitne users ke liye chahiye? Haan, 5 seats ke liye approx 15,000 rupees par month hoga. Kripya next Monday 10 AM ko callback kijiye, tab owner se baat ho payegi.
